source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
DartPoints Columbus publishes 2.5 MW of IT capacity. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, that is roughly 63 racks; at 10 kW per rack, a more typical colocation density, it is roughly 250 racks. Neither figure is the operator's claim, and no further electrical or cooling specifications are published on the facility page.

No certifications are listed in the published specifications, so no qualification statements can be made about what regulated or sensitive workloads the campus is certified to host.

Indiana has six data center facilities mapped in this dataset, but only one, this campus, publishes a megawatt figure, making DartPoints Columbus both first and last in the state ranking by published IT capacity. Its 2.5 MW represents 100 percent of the published capacity in Indiana solely because no other operator in the state has published a comparable figure to this site. That arithmetic reflects a data gap more than a market position.
